# lab kl

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
KL-divergence: how far a model file or setting drifts from the full-precision reference (Q8_0).
Lower = closer to the original. Stops llama-swap while it runs and always starts it again.
One-time setup (needs the 29 GB Q8_0 file and about 4 GB for the reference):
  lab kl base
Then, for each thing to measure:
  lab kl test "Q4_K_XL as served"
  lab kl test "Q4_K_XL, q8_0 context" -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0
  MODEL=/models/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q5_K_XL.gguf lab kl test "Q5_K_XL"
  lab kl --dry-run test "x"     print the commands, change nothing
Good result: "mean KLD" in the logged summary, then "== starting llama-swap".
```

Usage:

```
lab kl [--dry-run] base | test <note> [llama-perplexity options]
```
